# Powder-spreading theory: numbers (generated by `analysis/powder/powder_theory.py`)

PSD: log-normal by volume, D50 36 µm, σ_ln 0.36, sieved 15–63 µm → D10/D50/D90 = 22.7 / 35.2 / 52.0 µm. Below 20 µm: 4.7 % of the mass, 22 % of the particles.

Equivalent JKR work of adhesion at D = 36 µm: smooth 33 mJ/m², rms 1 nm 3.44, rms 3 nm 0.98, rms 10 nm 0.267 mJ/m² (DEM-calibrated AlSi10Mg values: 0.5–3.5, Girnth 2024; 0.8, Ye 2026).
Mass fraction with Bo > 1 / 10 / 100 at rms 3 nm: 1.00 / 1.00 / 0.35.

## 2. Moisture

A full water meniscus between two D50 spheres pulls 4.0 µN (Bo ≈ 6647); a meniscus held at a 50 nm asperity pulls 23 nN (Bo ≈ 38). Kelvin radius: RH 0.004 → 0.09 nm, RH 0.1 → 0.23 nm, RH 0.3 → 0.43 nm, RH 0.5 → 0.75 nm, RH 0.7 → 1.46 nm. 0.52 nm = gamma*Vm/(R*T) for water at 25 C; RH 0.4 % is a -40 C dew point at 25 C.

## 5. Blade loads

| module | dose per 30 µm layer (g) | pile weight (N/m) | pile section (mm²) | push force at μ_eff 1 / 10 (mN) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S25 | 0.036 | 0.008 | 0.00 | 0.4 / 4 |
| M50 | 0.144 | 0.020 | 0.00 | 1.4 / 14 |
| L75 | 0.326 | 0.034 | 0.00 | 3.2 / 32 |

One coarse particle jammed between the HSS blade and the part, flattened at ~1.3 GPa: D 57 µm squeezed 5 µm → 291 mN; D 63 µm squeezed 10 µm → 643 mN; D 63 µm squeezed 20 µm → 1286 mN. The as-built holder deflects 0.34 µm/N (FEA case 4).

## 6. The 200 °C plate

Rise of the plate top from 25 °C to 200 °C with a cool piston head: plate 10 mm 6061/5083 42 µm, heater block 14 mm 6061 62 µm, Macor standoffs 8 mm 7 µm; **total 112 µm**. Blade edge drop per K of holder (31 mm 6061) + blade (18 mm HSS): 0.94 µm/K; a 180 mm aluminium Z path: 4.3 µm/K. A 60 µm powder layer reaches the plate temperature in ~29 ms (time constant).
